parole.significato: A traditional Yemenite Jewish pull-apart yeast bread.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Hebrew כובאנה, from Yemeni Arabic كبانة.

parole.significato: A Middle Eastern hot sauce made from fresh hot peppers seasoned with coriander, garlic, and various spices.
parole.testo: From Hebrew סְחוּג (skhug), from Yemeni Arabic سحوق (sḥūg).
